ऋत्विय, ऋत्व्य a.
1 Due, regular.
--2 Conforming to, or familiar with,
ceremonial rules.
--3
Menstruating.
--4 Being in the period most
favourable to conception. --n.
Menstruation.

1 Due, regular.
--2 Conforming to, or familiar with,
ceremonial rules.
--3
Menstruating.
--4 Being in the period most
favourable to conception. --n.
Menstruation.

ऋत्विज् a. Ved. Sacrificing at
the proper season or regularly,
[]
--m. A priest who officiates at a
sacrifice; यज्ञस्य देवमृत्विजं
Rv. 1. 1. 1; ऋत्विग्यज्ञकृदुच्यते Y. 1. 35; cf.
Ms. 2. 143 also; the four chief
Ṛtvijas are होतृ, उद्गातृ, अध्वर्यु and
ब्रह्मन्; at grand ceremonies 16 are
enumerated.
